notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines the three session-obligation sends (CMSG_PING with sequence+lastRtt, CMSG_LOGOUT_REQUEST/CMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL, CMSG_COMPLETE_CINEMATIC) plus their answers. MSUI sends all four (ping body with counters, empty logout/cancel/cinematic bodies) and handles SMSG_PONG, SMSG_LOGOUT_RESPONSE, SMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL_ACK, SMSG_LOGOUT_COMPLETE and SMSG_TRIGGER_CINEMATIC (acked as an immediate ESC-style skip).
